payload.query:
query shopCatalog {
  shopCatalog {
    groups {
      ...subscriptionGroupFlatFields
    }
    subscriptions {
      ...subscriptionFields
      design
    }
  }
}

fragment subscriptionGroupFlatFields on SubscriptionGroupFlat {
  id
  name
  type
  shortDescription
  longDescription
  iconUrl
  backgroundColor
  role
  weight
  subscriptions
  subscriptionsImages {
    id
    imageUrl
  }
  parentId
  bannerType
  bannerPosition
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionFields on Subscription {
  id
  name
  role
  type
  description
  weight
  createDate
  updateDate
  deleteDate
  labels
  displayCardIcon
  displayCardSize
  plans {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  discounts {
    id
    type
  }
  configuration {
    subjectIds
    categoryIds
    chatRequests
    giftChatRequests
    tasksCount
    studentsQuantityInClassroom
    unlimitedAccessToTeachersTasks
    hintsForTeachersTasks
  }
  classObjectId
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionPlanFields on SubscriptionPlan {
  id
  numberOfStudents
  pricingPolicy
  period
  price
  timeline
  priceBefore
  pricePerMonth
  pricePerMonthBefore
  discount
  quotaOfTasks
  coins
  subjectPrices {
    id
    subjectId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
  categoryPrices {
    id
    categoryId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
}
